Formula for Planetary gear systems:
Sun Teeth = ringTeeth - 2 * planetTeeth
Planet Teeth = (ringTeeth - sunTeeth) / 2

PlanetCarrierSpeed = RT/(ST+RT) * RingSpeed + ST/(ST+RT) * SunSpeed
